why_it_moved.text: No segment cuts were read, so the mechanism is not known; the only change between arms is the ranker model.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: A pre-exposure comparison showing the arms already differed on Successful Search Rate would put the result in doubt.
A daily series by days since first exposure showing the lift fading toward zero would put the result in doubt.
A latency or abandonment reading outside its registered margin on a rerun would reverse the call.
